records.allowed_wording: On the frozen v12 protocol, Freq-HRL reduced the registered responsibility-space lower-LF diagnostic and met return noninferiority in HalfCheetah-v5, Hopper-v5, and Walker2d-v5. This result does not establish separation of the pre-routing lower action or the upper-action high-frequency budget.
records.claim: Freq-HRL reduces responsibility-space lower LF drift without harming return across the registered MuJoCo tasks.
records.forbidden_wording: MuJoCo v12 proves raw behavioral frequency separation or universal no-tradeoff.

records.allowed_wording: The stricter frozen v13 behavioral claim failed: HalfCheetah-v5 missed the raw lower-LF reduction gate and Hopper-v5 missed the upper-HF budget; Walker2d-v5 passed all registered gates. Return noninferiority and responsibility-space reduction passed in all three tasks.
records.claim: Freq-HRL simultaneously preserves return, reduces responsibility and raw lower LF drift, and bounds upper HF action power across all registered MuJoCo tasks.
records.forbidden_wording: Freq-HRL has confirmatory support for raw behavioral frequency separation across all MuJoCo tasks.

records.allowed_wording: Across 24 independent training replicates, eight held-out paths per replicate, and six registered scenarios, Freq-HRL v7.4 supported improvement in 8 of 12 Holm-controlled pooled contrasts. Its return was significantly worse than matched generic HRL-GRU-PPO, while its return contrast with matched SAC and both drift contrasts with generic HRL variants were inconclusive.
records.claim: Freq-HRL outperforms every matched learned baseline on pooled return and lower-LF drift.
records.forbidden_wording: Freq-HRL uniformly dominates all matched PPO, recurrent HRL, SAC, and TD3 baselines.

records.allowed_wording: The v14 development screen found no fixed endpoint-aligned coefficient that passed all four safety gates in all three MuJoCo tasks; it motivates adaptive or constrained upper-policy training. These outcomes are not confirmatory evidence.
records.claim: A fixed endpoint-aligned leakage coefficient is behavior-safe across all registered MuJoCo tasks.
records.forbidden_wording: MuJoCo v14 supports a positive performance or behavior claim, or supplies held-out confirmation for a later algorithm.

records.allowed_wording: The v14.1 development screen evaluated crossed-condition checkpoint selection, the strongest v14 static arm, and three upper primal-dual rates. No arm passed the preregistered return and behavioral gates in all 15 environment-by-disturbance conditions; every candidate passed zero complete condition gates. These outcomes are development evidence only.
records.claim: Crossed-condition checkpoint selection and upper primal-dual training produce a behavior-safe MuJoCo candidate.
records.forbidden_wording: MuJoCo v14.1 validates behavior-safe upper primal-dual Freq-HRL or supplies confirmatory evidence for any selected arm.

records.allowed_wording: The v14.2 development screen corrected the leakage-cost scale and showed that full causal high-pass routing reduced raw and responsibility lower-LF drift in every registered environment-by-disturbance condition. No arm was behavior-safe overall: the best arm passed 2 of 15 complete condition gates, full routing harmed return or lower-action activity, and upper primal-dual variants saturated in at least one environment. These outcomes motivate partial-strength routing and are not confirmatory evidence.
records.claim: Physical-scale leakage costs and a causal lower-action high-pass router produce a behavior-safe MuJoCo candidate.
records.forbidden_wording: MuJoCo v14.2 validates physical behavioral separation, no-tradeoff, or any selected confirmatory Freq-HRL algorithm.

records.allowed_wording: The v14.3 development screen tested seven fixed partial-strength causal lower-action routers on fresh seeds. Every arm reduced responsibility-space lower-LF drift in all 15 environment-by-disturbance conditions, but no arm jointly passed return and raw-behavior gates everywhere. The best arm passed 4 of 15 complete conditions and 10 of 15 strict raw-drift gates. These outcomes motivate a training-time routing curriculum and are not confirmatory evidence.
records.claim: A fixed partial-strength causal lower-action router produces behavior-safe physical separation across the registered MuJoCo conditions.
records.forbidden_wording: MuJoCo v14.3 validates fixed partial-strength routing, physical no-tradeoff, or any selected confirmatory Freq-HRL algorithm.

records.allowed_wording: The v14.4 development screen exposed router strength to both policies and tested seven frozen constant or delayed homotopy schedules on fresh seeds. No schedule was behavior-safe across all 15 environment-by-disturbance conditions. The best joint arm passed 3 of 15 complete conditions. The fastest ramp met return noninferiority in 10 of 15 conditions but met responsibility and raw-drift gates in only 5 each, indicating policy compensation rather than stable physical separation. These outcomes motivate paired checkpoint continuation and are not confirmatory evidence.
records.claim: An observed training-time router homotopy produces behavior-safe physical separation across the registered MuJoCo conditions.
records.forbidden_wording: MuJoCo v14.4 validates router homotopy, physical no-tradeoff, or any selected confirmatory Freq-HRL algorithm.

records.allowed_wording: The v14.5 development screen started every candidate and its compute-matched direct comparator from the same serialized policy and optimizer state. Actor-space proximal constraints stabilized latent policy movement, and two arms met both raw and responsibility drift gates in all 15 conditions. No arm was behavior-safe overall: every routed arm met return noninferiority in only the five Walker2d conditions, Hopper missed the upper-HF budget, and no arm met the trained-checkpoint gate. This identifies a function-discontinuous router intervention rather than optimizer initialization as the remaining defect.
records.claim: Paired checkpoint continuation with actor-space proximal constraints produces behavior-safe physical separation across the registered MuJoCo conditions.
records.forbidden_wording: MuJoCo v14.5 validates paired proximal routing, physical no-tradeoff, or any selected confirmatory Freq-HRL algorithm.

records.allowed_wording: The v14.6 development screen made lower-to-upper transfer function preserving and excluded untrained checkpoints. Every candidate exactly matched its paired control in selected parameters, latent-policy traces, executed-action traces, rewards, and returns. Strengths at or above 0.075 reduced both registered lower-LF diagnostics in all 15 conditions, but every such arm failed the upper-HF budget in all five Hopper conditions and passed only 10 of 15 complete gates. Because policy parameters and environment behavior were identical across arms, this is a responsibility-coordinate diagnostic rather than evidence of improved learned control.
records.claim: Function-preserving conservative responsibility transfer produces behavior-safe learned frequency separation across the registered MuJoCo conditions.
records.forbidden_wording: MuJoCo v14.6 validates learned behavior-safe Freq-HRL, improves control performance, or supplies a selected algorithm for confirmatory testing.

records.allowed_wording: The v14.7 single-replicate preflight validated pathwise projection calibration and confirmed that learned arms changed actor behavior, but the learned arms used a behavior-robust checkpoint selector while the comparator used mean reward. The result is excluded from algorithm selection.
records.claim: Joint learned projection improves reward and both latent and executed frequency endpoints in MuJoCo.
records.forbidden_wording: MuJoCo v14.7 supports reward improvement, learned frequency separation, no-tradeoff behavior, or any confirmatory candidate.

records.allowed_wording: The v14.8 single-replicate HalfCheetah preflight removed the v14.7 comparator and actor-identity confounds. Projection-only calibration was pathwise exact, but no learned arm combined reward preservation with latent lower- and upper-frequency improvement. Equal upper and lower dual rates operated at incompatible cost scales.
records.claim: Selector-matched learned projection jointly preserves reward and improves latent lower- and upper-frequency endpoints.
records.forbidden_wording: MuJoCo v14.8 supports a learned no-tradeoff result, cross-task generality, reward improvement, or confirmatory evidence.

records.allowed_wording: The v14.9 HalfCheetah development extension found that one asymmetric arm improved mean return in four modes and reduced latent upper-HF power, but worsened every mean lower-frequency endpoint. The audit showed that stochastic rollout-action constraints did not match deterministic deployment actions.
records.claim: Asymmetric feasibility-aware primal-dual training yields joint deployed frequency separation without reward tradeoff.
records.forbidden_wording: MuJoCo v14.9 supports joint learned frequency separation, no-tradeoff behavior, cross-task generality, confirmatory reward improvement, or a submission-ready selected algorithm.

records.allowed_wording: The source-bound v14.10 preflight validated deterministic deployment-frequency gradients, projection calibration, provenance, and held-out-grid integrity. Every learned arm fell back to the initial checkpoint because single-step corrections were smaller than the registered targets.
records.claim: Deployment-aligned deterministic frequency projection admits a behavior-safe learned checkpoint.
records.forbidden_wording: MuJoCo v14.10 supports learned frequency separation, reward improvement, no-tradeoff behavior, cross-task generality, confirmatory evidence, or a selected algorithm.

records.allowed_wording: The source-bound v14.11 preflight showed that iterative deterministic projection increased same-batch frequency reduction without surrogate reward-budget violations. Every learned arm nevertheless selected the fallback because pooled improvements did not satisfy worst-condition reward and frequency ranks.
records.claim: Iterative deterministic projection admits a behavior-safe learned checkpoint.
records.forbidden_wording: MuJoCo v14.11 supports an accepted learned checkpoint, reward improvement, no-tradeoff behavior, cross-task generality, confirmatory evidence, or a selected algorithm.

records.allowed_wording: The source-bound v14.12 preflight preserved four rollout groups and zero per-group surrogate reward-budget violations, but no arm met every paired reward floor and frequency target at an eligible learned checkpoint.
records.claim: Per-group robust projection admits a behavior-safe learned checkpoint.
records.forbidden_wording: MuJoCo v14.12 supports an accepted learned checkpoint, reward improvement, no-tradeoff behavior, cross-task generality, confirmatory evidence, or a selected algorithm.

records.allowed_wording: The source-bound v14.13 preflight validated exact projection calibration, frozen anchor replay, and finite-budget PPO trust regions. All learned arms selected the fallback because trained checkpoints still failed unseen-seed closed-loop frequency endpoints.
records.claim: Frozen anchor replay and PPO trust regions close the training-state versus deployment-state gap.
records.forbidden_wording: MuJoCo v14.13 supports an accepted learned checkpoint, reward improvement, learned frequency separation, statistical evidence, confirmatory evidence, or a selected algorithm.

records.allowed_wording: The source-bound v14.14 preflight executed the independent closed-loop guard but accepted zero effective actor updates. It identified a feasible-set maintenance rule incorrectly applied at an infeasible starting point.
records.claim: Strict closed-loop actor backtracking admits a behavior-safe learned checkpoint from an infeasible anchor.
records.forbidden_wording: MuJoCo v14.14 supports an accepted learned checkpoint, reward improvement, learned frequency separation, statistical evidence, confirmatory evidence, or a selected algorithm.

records.allowed_wording: The source-bound v14.15 HalfCheetah preflight selected the restoration arm with reward tolerance 0.005, eight backtracks, and funnel multiplier 3. It accepted 22 effective joint actor updates, reduced 20 closed-loop frequency violations and continuous violation merit to zero under the reward floor, and passed all five held-out disturbance gates. This single-seed result authorizes a fresh multiseed development screen only.
records.claim: Two-phase closed-loop restoration admits a complete-gate learned checkpoint and authorizes multiseed development.
records.forbidden_wording: MuJoCo v14.15 preflight alone supports statistically reliable reward improvement, robust frequency separation, no-tradeoff behavior, cross-environment generality, confirmatory evidence, or a submission-ready algorithm.

records.allowed_wording: The repaired v14.15 r2 development screen completed all 450 frozen cells across 15 fresh optimizer seeds and three MuJoCo environments. The preselected restoration arm was not ready for confirmation: only 8 of 45 environment-by-seed candidate cells passed the complete gate (HalfCheetah 0, Hopper 7, Walker2d 1), and the simultaneous primary family failed. Training often restored the independent guard paths, but checkpoint selection exposed poor transfer to disjoint paths, motivating broader frozen-state coverage and restoration-specific regularization.
records.claim: The v14.15 restoration candidate generalizes across optimizer seeds and MuJoCo environments sufficiently to authorize fresh confirmation.
records.forbidden_wording: MuJoCo v14.15 provides confirmatory evidence, establishes cross-environment learned frequency separation, supports a no-tradeoff claim, or is ready for submission as the final algorithm.

records.allowed_wording: The source-bound v14.16 development screen recovered and validated all 81 registered cells. The preregistered crossed-replay arm passed neither the engineering nor complete effect gate in any of nine environment-by-seed cells; eight cells retained the fallback checkpoint. The non-frozen pathwise arm was the best diagnostic variant but completed only the Hopper environment and 2 of 9 cell-level gates. These results reject binary reward-actor freezing and all-path hard feasibility as the next scalable mechanism.
records.claim: Pathwise restoration, reward-actor freezing, and crossed frozen-state replay produce a stable learned leakage-constrained MuJoCo candidate.
records.forbidden_wording: MuJoCo v14.16 supports learned cross-environment frequency separation, a no-tradeoff claim, a statistically reliable improvement, or expansion of the preregistered primary arm to confirmation.

records.allowed_wording: On the preregistered v14.29 protocol, the guarded restoration portfolio was supported for 16 of 16 fresh optimizer seeds in HalfCheetah-v5, 16 of 16 in Hopper-v5, and 15 of 16 in Walker2d-v5; the corresponding two-sided 95% Wilson lower bounds were 0.8064, 0.8064, and 0.7167. Thirty-eight cells selected function-preserving routers with exact paired action, reward, and latent-policy trace invariance, nine Walker2d cells selected guarded actor updates, and one Walker2d cell abstained and counted as failure. All supported cells respected the held-out reward floor.
records.claim: A frozen guarded restoration portfolio restores frequency responsibility under a reward floor across fresh optimizer seeds in the registered MuJoCo tasks.
records.forbidden_wording: MuJoCo v14.29 proves reward improvement, universal raw behavioral separation, that every environment is restored solely by function-preserving routing, or success beyond the frozen validation-path panel.

records.allowed_wording: Across v15, v15.1, and v15.2 development preflights, Hopper-v5 passed the joint raw-policy and reward-floor validation gate, while HalfCheetah-v5 and Walker2d-v5 did not admit a universally valid candidate. These single-optimizer-seed outcomes do not justify fresh-seed confirmation.
records.claim: Post-hoc causal responsibility distillation identifies a raw upper/lower policy factorization that satisfies all frequency endpoints and the reward floor across the registered MuJoCo tasks.
records.forbidden_wording: The v15 development sequence validates universal raw behavioral separation, fresh-seed generalization, reward improvement, or a confirmatory Freq-HRL algorithm.

records.allowed_wording: In a frozen three-environment, three-optimizer-seed development preflight, the causal total-action gauge reconstructed the additive action in all nine paired cells, but the EMA gauge did not satisfy the joint frequency and reward gate: canonical frequency reduction passed 0 of 9 cells and reward noninferiority passed 6 of 9.
records.claim: A full-strength causal total-action gauge combined with primal-dual training yields cross-environment frequency separation without a reward tradeoff.
records.forbidden_wording: The v16 development preflight validates training-time raw separation, leakage no-tradeoff, reward improvement, fresh-seed confirmation, or a final Freq-HRL algorithm.

records.allowed_wording: In a frozen three-environment, three-optimizer-seed development preflight, the audit-adaptive gauge exactly reconstructed the additive action and preserved held-out reward noninferiority in all nine paired cells, but only one cell reached the canonical frequency-reduction gate and no environment reached the required two-of-three replicate gate.
records.claim: An audit-adaptive exact total-action gauge combined with paired primal-dual continuation yields cross-environment raw responsibility separation without a reward tradeoff.
records.forbidden_wording: The v16.1 development preflight validates cross-environment raw responsibility separation, reward improvement, leakage no-tradeoff, fresh-seed confirmation, or a final Freq-HRL algorithm.

records.allowed_wording: In a frozen three-environment, three-optimizer-seed development screen, the macro-hold gauge exactly reconstructed the additive action in all nine cells, but only two cells passed the joint reward-and-frequency gate and no environment reached the required two-of-three replicate gate. The piecewise-constant upper responsibility improved lower-frequency separation in Hopper and Walker2d but failed structurally in HalfCheetah and exceeded the upper-frequency budget in five cells.
records.claim: A macro-held exact total-action gauge yields cross-environment responsibility separation without a reward tradeoff while preserving the upper decision rate.
records.forbidden_wording: The v16.2 development screen validates cross-environment responsibility separation, reward improvement, leakage no-tradeoff, fresh-seed confirmation, or a final Freq-HRL algorithm.

records.allowed_wording: In a frozen three-environment, three-optimizer-seed development screen, exact causal zero-DC projection enforced the complete-macro lower invariant and reduced both pre-saturation raw lower-LF power and normalized raw joint frequency merit in all nine cells. The joint no-tradeoff claim failed: held-out reward noninferiority passed only three cells, candidate upper-HF reduction passed five, only one cell passed every gate, and no environment reached the required two-of-three replicate gate.
records.claim: A smooth macro upper plan and causal exact zero-DC lower projector yield cross-environment pre-saturation frequency separation without a reward tradeoff.
records.forbidden_wording: The v17 development screen validates reward no-tradeoff, cross-environment upper/lower frequency separation, plant-level separation after saturation, fresh-seed confirmation, or a final Freq-HRL algorithm.

records.allowed_wording: In a frozen three-environment, one-optimizer-seed development preflight, every v17.1 candidate enforced the complete-macro zero-DC invariant, exactly reconstructed the registered responsibility sum, and reduced raw lower-LF power relative to smooth direct control and its own latent proposal. No candidate met the reward floor in more than one environment, so no arm advanced to fresh multiseed evaluation.
records.claim: Headroom-feasible zero-DC training with a continuous homotopy and causal upper promotion yields cross-environment frequency separation without a reward tradeoff.
records.forbidden_wording: The v17.1 development preflight validates reward no-tradeoff, cross-environment upper/lower frequency separation, exact plant-level headroom after float32 execution, fresh-seed confirmation, or a final Freq-HRL algorithm.

records.allowed_wording: In a frozen three-environment paired development preflight, gauge strengths zero and one exactly matched reward, executed-action, and latent-policy traces on all 360 paired paths, validating pathwise function preservation. No alpha achieved the registered lower-LPF32 or joint-merit reduction in any environment, so the naive EMA-target smooth macro gauge was rejected without multiseed expansion.
records.claim: A causal endpoint-exact smooth macro gauge yields cross-environment upper/lower frequency responsibility separation while preserving the frozen control path.
records.forbidden_wording: The v17.2 development preflight validates frequency separation, leakage no-tradeoff, reward improvement, learned constraint improvement, optimizer-seed robustness, fresh-seed confirmation, or a final Freq-HRL algorithm.

records.allowed_wording: In a frozen three-environment paired development preflight, v17.3 exactly preserved reward, executed-action, and latent-policy traces on all 120 paired paths. It reduced lower-LPF32 and normalized joint merit in Hopper and Walker2d, but upper-HPF8 worsened in every environment and all three endpoints worsened in HalfCheetah, so the mechanism was rejected without multiseed expansion.
records.claim: A causal macro gauge that directly minimizes the registered HPF8/LPF32 objective yields cross-environment frequency responsibility separation while preserving the frozen control path.
records.forbidden_wording: The v17.3 development preflight validates cross-environment frequency separation, leakage no-tradeoff, reward improvement, learned constraint improvement, optimizer-seed robustness, fresh-seed confirmation, or a final Freq-HRL algorithm.

records.allowed_wording: In a frozen three-environment paired development preflight, v17.4 exactly preserved reward, executed-action, and latent-policy traces on all 120 paired paths. It reduced lower-LPF32 by 60.3--90.4% and normalized joint merit by 41.2--88.0% in every environment, while all three candidate upper-HPF8 powers met the absolute budget. The strict expansion rule still failed because only Walker2d met the absolute lower-LPF32 budget and HalfCheetah missed the upper-budget feasibility threshold.
records.claim: A causal receding projection with complete streaming HPF8/LPF32 state attains fixed upper and lower frequency budgets across MuJoCo while preserving the frozen control path.
records.forbidden_wording: The v17.4 development preflight validates the all-environment absolute frequency contract, leakage no-tradeoff, reward improvement, optimizer-seed robustness, fresh-seed confirmation, or a final Freq-HRL algorithm.

records.allowed_wording: On rejected v17.4 development paths, v17.5 eliminated current-step normalized budget regret in all three environments but improved full-trajectory lower-LPF32 in only one and upper-HPF8 in none. This diagnostic motivated a full-horizon frozen-total-action oracle.
records.claim: A current-step feasibility-normalized projection improves full-trajectory upper and lower frequency endpoints across MuJoCo.
records.forbidden_wording: The v17.5 diagnostic validates feasibility-normalized projection, reward improvement, full-trajectory leakage improvement, fresh-seed performance, or a final Freq-HRL algorithm.

records.allowed_wording: On 120 rejected v17.4 development paths, a numerically audited full-horizon oracle recovered 81 paths that the causal online split did not make jointly feasible. Seven Hopper paths remained above the lower-LPF32 budget after imposing the upper-HPF8 budget, separating a router-rebuild target from an actor-level total-action feasibility target.
records.claim: A bounded full-horizon responsibility oracle distinguishes online-router failures from total-action frequency infeasibility on frozen MuJoCo trajectories.
records.forbidden_wording: The v17.6 acausal reused-path oracle validates an online Freq-HRL policy, reward improvement, cross-seed generalization, deployment feasibility, or a final algorithm.

records.allowed_wording: On 120 reused fixed-total-action development paths, v17.8 used eight leave-one-seed-out folds and selected a causal multivariate FIR that met the upper budget on every path but recovered only 7 of 81 oracle-recoverable failures and preserved 0 of 32 baseline-feasible Walker2d paths. The fresh validation panel was not accessed. A diagnostic gain-one candidate recovered 58 failures and preserved all 32 Walker2d paths but met the upper budget on only 90 paths, motivating high-frequency innovation projection rather than global gain reduction.
records.claim: A multivariate causal FIR distilled from full-horizon responsibility oracles generalizes across held-out MuJoCo seeds while satisfying both registered frequency budgets.
records.forbidden_wording: The v17.8 reused-path distillation validates fresh-seed generalization, both frequency budgets, reward improvement, closed-loop learning, leakage no-tradeoff, or a final Freq-HRL algorithm.

records.allowed_wording: On 120 reused grouped out-of-fold development paths, v17.9 met the upper budget everywhere, improved mean lower power in every environment, recovered all 40 HalfCheetah and all 8 Walker2d oracle-recoverable failures, and preserved all 32 baseline-feasible Walker2d paths. It recovered 0 of 33 Hopper failures, so the 48/81 total missed the frozen advancement gate and no fresh path was accessed.
records.claim: Projecting only a distilled causal FIR router's upper high-frequency innovation satisfies both responsibility budgets across MuJoCo.
records.forbidden_wording: The v17.9 reused-path prefix projection validates fresh-seed generalization, the all-environment frequency contract, reward improvement, closed-loop learning, leakage no-tradeoff, or a final Freq-HRL algorithm.

records.allowed_wording: On reused grouped development paths, the frozen v17.10 selector retained the zero-reserve 48/81 solution. An 82-step reservoir diagnostic reached 63/81 recovery and 120/120 endpoint upper compliance, but only 113/120 paths maintained the causal envelope and Hopper recovery was 15/33; no fresh path was accessed.
records.claim: A causal minimum-horizon upper-energy reservoir closes the short-episode Hopper responsibility gap without violating endpoint budgets.
records.forbidden_wording: The v17.10 reused-path reservoir validates fresh-seed generalization, short-horizon endpoint certification, the all-environment frequency contract, reward improvement, closed-loop learning, or a final Freq-HRL algorithm.

records.allowed_wording: On 120 reused grouped development paths, the frozen v17.11 selector found a fractional reservoir that kept all paths valid and upper-feasible, recovered 62/81 oracle-recoverable failures, and preserved all 32 baseline-feasible Walker2d paths. Hopper recovery was only 14/33; even a one-invalid-path diagnostic reached only 16/33. No candidate passed the gate, no fresh path was accessed, and router-only fixed-total-action development was closed.
records.claim: Fractional release of minimum-horizon upper-energy credit closes the short-episode Hopper responsibility gap while preserving causal feasibility.
records.forbidden_wording: The v17.11 reused-path fractional reservoir validates fresh-seed generalization, the all-environment frequency contract, reward improvement, closed-loop learning, leakage no-tradeoff, or a final Freq-HRL algorithm.

records.allowed_wording: On the unchanged 120-path development panel, v17.12 preserved all 113 reference-feasible paths and constructed feasible targets for all seven Hopper actor-floor paths. Their required total-action correction RMS averaged 0.002343 and was at most 0.008118; this authorizes causal actor-target distillation on reused paths.
records.claim: Router-irreducible responsibility failures admit nearby total-action targets satisfying the registered full-horizon frequency budgets.
records.forbidden_wording: The acausal v17.12 target oracle establishes an online policy, reward improvement, fresh-seed generalization, leakage no-tradeoff, or final Freq-HRL manuscript support.

records.allowed_wording: On 120 reused grouped paths, the selected v17.13 causal adapter preserved all 113 reference-feasible paths and changed every actor-floor executed action, but recovered only 3/7 actor-floor paths. The exact-oracle prefilter evaluated 48 gain-0.5/1.0 candidates; gain-1.5/2.0 candidates remained outside this oracle frontier, and no fresh path was accessed.
records.claim: A grouped causal actor residual distills nearest-feasible action targets while preserving previously feasible responsibility paths.
records.forbidden_wording: V17.13 validates actor-level frequency feasibility, reward improvement, online learning, fresh-seed generalization, leakage no-tradeoff, or final Freq-HRL manuscript support.

records.allowed_wording: On the unchanged 120-path development panel, all 900 members of the frozen linear causal FIR grid received exact responsibility oracles. Every candidate preserved all 113 reference-feasible paths; the best recovered 6/7 actor-floor paths, leaving one Hopper ood_chirp path unresolved. No candidate passed the advancement gate, so this grid was closed without fresh-path access.
records.claim: A complete exact-oracle audit determines whether the frozen linear causal FIR actor grid can recover every actor-floor responsibility failure while preserving feasible paths.
records.forbidden_wording: V17.14 proves a universal actor impossibility or establishes reward improvement, online learning, fresh-seed generalization, leakage no-tradeoff, or final Freq-HRL manuscript support.

records.allowed_wording: V18.1 exported and validated causal pretransition observation and lower-policy state traces for all 120 unchanged development paths. The export did not read actor-floor labels or target actions, and the 120 NPZ traces remain server-only.
records.claim: Causal pretransition actor-state traces can be reproduced and aligned with the unchanged reused-path MuJoCo development panel without reading target labels during export.
records.forbidden_wording: V18.1 establishes model quality, reward improvement, online learning, fresh-seed generalization, leakage no-tradeoff, or manuscript performance support.

records.allowed_wording: On the unchanged 120-path grouped development panel, every v18.2 candidate preserved all 113 reference-feasible paths. The best state MLP recovered only 3/7 actor-floor paths, versus 6/7 for v17.14, and failed the target-fidelity and complete-recovery gates; no fresh path was accessed.
records.claim: Grouped causal state conditioning transfers nearest-feasible actor corrections across held seed groups while preserving already feasible responsibility paths.
records.forbidden_wording: V18.2 validates state-conditioned actor correction, reward improvement, online learning, fresh-seed generalization, leakage no-tradeoff, or final Freq-HRL manuscript support.

records.allowed_wording: This snapshot may be used only to trace historical claim changes. Its individual rows require record-level re-adjudication before manuscript use.
records.claim: Historical raw-only C1-C9 matrix generated before the current independent audit.
records.forbidden_wording: The historical 1-of-9 count is the current authoritative paper conclusion.

records.allowed_wording: This file is retained as a historical diagnostic inventory, not as a manuscript evidence source.
records.claim: Historical paper diagnostics that mixed path, surrogate, native, and small-seed support labels.
records.forbidden_wording: A path test, three-seed surrogate interval, or mechanism diagnostic in the historical file establishes a confirmatory domain-general result.
